question_vi: Database migration với Flyway trong Spring Boot hoạt động thế nào?
question_en: How does database migration with Flyway work in Spring Boot?
answer_vi:
**Flyway** quản lý schema migration dạng **versioned SQL file** — audit trail, schema reproducible mọi môi trường. Thêm dependency `flyway-core` là Spring Boot tự tích hợp (từ Flyway 10 / Boot 3.2+, Postgres/MySQL cần thêm module riêng, vd `flyway-database-postgresql`).

**Quy ước:** script đặt ở `src/main/resources/db/migration/`, tên `V{version}__{description}.sql` — vd `V1__create_users_table.sql`, `V2__add_email_index.sql`. Nội dung là SQL thuần (`CREATE TABLE ...`).

**Auto-run khi startup:** Flyway apply mọi migration pending theo thứ tự version, lưu trạng thái (version, checksum, thời điểm) vào bảng **`flyway_schema_history`** — biết chính xác migration nào đã chạy.

**Config đáng nhớ:** `spring.flyway.baseline-on-migrate: true` (khi DB đã có schema từ trước), `validate-on-migrate: true` (checksum lệch → fail sớm).

**Quy tắc quan trọng:** **không sửa migration đã chạy** — checksum đổi → Flyway fail; luôn tạo file mới (`V4__alter_...`).

**Vs Liquibase:** Flyway đơn giản hơn (SQL thuần); Liquibase flexible hơn (YAML/XML, rollback tốt hơn)
answer_en:
**Flyway** manages schema migrations as **versioned SQL files** — audit trail, reproducible schema across environments. Add the `flyway-core` dependency and Spring Boot integrates it automatically (from Flyway 10 / Boot 3.2+, Postgres/MySQL need the DB-specific module, e.g. `flyway-database-postgresql`).

**Convention:** scripts live in `src/main/resources/db/migration/`, named `V{version}__{description}.sql` — e.g. `V1__create_users_table.sql`, `V2__add_email_index.sql`. Contents are plain SQL (`CREATE TABLE ...`).

**Auto-run at startup:** Flyway applies all pending migrations in version order, recording state (version, checksum, timestamp) in the **`flyway_schema_history`** table — it knows exactly which migrations have run.

**Config worth knowing:** `spring.flyway.baseline-on-migrate: true` (when the DB already has a schema), `validate-on-migrate: true` (checksum mismatch → fail fast).

**Key rule:** **never edit a migration that has run** — the checksum changes → Flyway fails; always create a new file (`V4__alter_...`).

**vs Liquibase:** Flyway is simpler (plain SQL); Liquibase is more flexible (YAML/XML, better rollbacks)
